en.p: For a cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient $1$, the function
is differentiable on the set of all real numbers and satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) The function $g(x)$ has a local minimum at $x=0$, and $g(0)>0$.

en.p: When the minimum possible value of $g(0)$ is $\dfrac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
